15. Thank you if you made it to the end of the dump. With the next lines wanted to ask you if you think I should put this sign at the start of my indie game? Would it make AI bros angry? As dev and as a player I really dislike AI, the impact on our society and the people behind it (freaking soulless lizards). I also am not to happy when I see other devs use it for their games. In ours I use no AI art, no AI writing, no AI music. And yet on several occasions someone from a streamer's chat playing our demo would ask if the voice acting is AI or if a video I used in the game is AI. So I decided to put this message at the start of the game to make that clear. My brother saw that and said he never saw that in any other game and we should remove it because "it's dumb". Should we remove it? Is there a chance it will piss the AI bros? P.S. Here is our Steam page if you want to support Games Made Without AI: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719670/The_Milgram_Experiment/

item.title: The Trans Migration is Already Happening
item.description: A few weeks ago, a completely ordinary stop at a grocery store made me realize I was watching something much bigger happen around me: trans people are uprooting their lives and moving across the United States in search of places where they can safely exist. Check out the full video here for a more comprehensive look: https://youtu.be/AoxXo9QXv4A (All my YouTube revenue goes to trans charities btw) Live chatting there at 7:30am PST Washington has increasingly become one of those places. This isn't meant to be a comprehensive statistical breakdown of trans migration. It's a personal observation about something I've been watching happen among my friends, my community, and now apparently in the aisles of a grocery store in Spokane. There's something genuinely wonderful about seeing trans people simply existing together without fear. I just wish the reason so many of us are ending up here wasn't so fucking bleak. Resources if you are looking for help right now: Project Open Arms - Traction PNW https://tractionpnw.org/open-arms/ Queer Trans Project https://queertransproject.org/ Washington State LGBTQ Resources https://lgbtq.wa.gov/resources/county... Gender Justice League - Trans Resourceshttps://genderjusticeleague.org/trans... Stand With Transhttps://standwithtrans.org/ TransLash - Trans Relocation Guide: Finding Trans Asylum & Safe Havens https://translash.org/resources/trans-relocation-guide-finding-trans-asylum-and-safe-havens/
